Section 4.2, Prior authorization for outpatient MRI: Outpatient magnetic resonance imaging requires prior authorization from the Plan. Prior authorization is not required where the MRI was ordered on the written referral of a board-certified specialist. Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Specialist referral (SPECIALIST_REFERRAL).

Evidence required for an appeal under this section: Retroactive authorization request (RETRO_AUTH_REQUEST), Physician letter of medical necessity (PHYSICIAN_NECESSITY_LETTER).
